community.title: Release review video available!
content: We released a major milestone update for MobiFlight, version 11.2, which includes several new features and improvements.
Check out our video showcasing the new features and enhancements!

community.title: MOZA is new MobiFlight partner
content: MobiFlight is excited to announce our new partnership with MOZA.
We want to thank MOZA for their support and we are looking forward to a successful collaboration.

community.title: Exclusive offers for partner products
content: Checkout our newly created shop section for partner products.
MobiFlight users receive **exclusive discounts** and every purchase supports our community.

community.title: MobiFlight back from AERO2026
content: The MobiFlight team is back from AERO2026, where we had an amazing time connecting with the aviation community.
**We want to thank everyone** who stopped by our booth and shared their passion for flight simulation with us!

media.alt: Meet the MobiFlight team at AERO2026

community.title: Flight Sim Awards 2026
content: MobiFlight received the community award at the Flight Sim Awards 2026, recognizing our contributions to the flight simulation community.
**We are honored and grateful for this recognition!**

media.alt: MobiFlight receiving the community award at Flight Sim Awards 2026
